services.name: K-12 Field Trips
services.desc: The Turner welcomes K-12 field trips on Tuesday and Thursday from 9:30am-12pm during scheduled exhibitions. All field trips are free and include a guided tour and hands-on art activity, led by Turner staff. Our class visits are 60-90 minutes depending on what you would like to do and how many students are in your visit. You can choose from the following options when booking: The maximum number the gallery can accommodate at one time is 25. Larger groups of up to 75 students may visit in shifts.
